:doctype: manpage

:manmanual: Callout checks

== Name
prefix-spaces-subs - substituted content before comment prefixes

== Synopsis

[source,ruby,line-comment="// ",subs="+macros,+quotes"]
----
S01 link:https://example.org/[Link] // <1>
S02 *Bold* // <1>
S03 anchor:target[]target // <1>
S04 pass:[// ]<1>
S05 **//** <1>
S06 footnote:note[Note.] // <1>
----
<1> Parsed neighbors and protected prefixes.

[source,ruby,line-comment="// ",subs="-callouts"]
----
S07 disabled // <1>
S08 disabled // \<1>
----

See <<target>>.
